en_title: ‘We Vibe Coded a New Epic Games Launcher’ – Epic’s New Store App Was Built Using AI
cn_title: Epic用生成式AI打造新版启动器
subtitle: 「编程太难了」
opus_summary: Epic公布借助生成式AI开发的新版启动器，称其速度更快、响应更灵敏。商城负责人表示，AI主要用于代码效率和架构，美术与设计风格仍由原有设计团队负责。

paragraphs.en: Epic has revealed a newly refreshed version of the Epic Games Launcher , its Steam-like platform that provides access to the Epic Games Store, your games library, social features, and a developer’s hub. In keeping with the company’s interest in and push for AI-assisted development , this new version of the launcher has been created using generative artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.cn: Epic公布了焕新后的Epic Games启动器。这个类似Steam的平台集成了Epic Games商城、游戏库、社交功能和开发者中心。Epic一直关注并推动AI辅助开发，新版启动器也使用了生成式人工智能来开发。

paragraphs.en: “Programming is hard,” wrote Epic in a new blog post . “So, instead of doing that, we vibe coded a new Epic Games Launcher that’s way faster and more responsive than the current one, and has a new look.”
paragraphs.cn: Epic在一篇新博文中写道：「编程很难。所以，我们没去写代码，而是用氛围编程做了一个新的Epic Games启动器。它比当前版本快得多，响应也更灵敏，还换上了新外观。」

paragraphs.en: The term “vibe coding” is often used in a joke context to describe code developed entirely through AI prompts, rather than actual coding expertise. It’s interesting, then, to see Epic use the term in an announcement for its own product. But just how has the company approached the build of its new app?
paragraphs.cn: 「氛围编程」（vibe coding）一词常用于调侃，指完全依靠AI提示词、而非实际编程技能来编写代码。因此，看到Epic在自家产品的公告中使用这个词，倒也颇有意思。不过，该公司究竟是如何开发这款新应用的呢？

paragraphs.en: During an interview with IGN, vice president and general manager of Epic Games Store Martin Keely discussed how the technology has been used. “We have used AI as a tool as part of our development process,” he said. “It's obviously an issue that's of high visibility at the moment across the industry, but for us, it made us more efficient and allowed a small team to rewrite the code base and be able to launch it faster across platforms, support Windows and Mac, and we're going to have a Linux version as well.”
paragraphs.cn: Epic Games商城副总裁兼总经理Martin Keely在接受IGN采访时，谈到了这项技术的使用方式。他说：「我们在开发过程中把AI当作工具来使用。显然，这个话题目前在整个行业都备受关注。但对我们来说，AI提高了效率，让一支小团队得以重写代码库，并更快地在多个平台上推出新版启动器。它支持Windows和Mac，我们还会推出Linux版本。」

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg’s recent report claims that developers at Epic have been encouraged to use Anthropic’s AI assistant, Claude, and that work on an upcoming Star Wars/Marvel crossover project should be conducted with "no more hand-written code.” Meanwhile, Epic’s founder and CEO, Tim Sweeney, said on X/Twitter that the company is "moving developers around to retool for maximum AI acceleration."
paragraphs.cn: 彭博社近日报道称，Epic鼓励开发者使用Anthropic的AI助手Claude，并要求即将推出的《星球大战》与漫威联动项目「不再手写代码」。与此同时，Epic创始人兼首席执行官蒂姆·斯维尼在X上表示，公司正在「调整开发者的岗位，重整开发方式，最大限度地利用AI加速开发」。

paragraphs.en: When asked to clarify the extent of Epic’s use of artificial intelligence on the new launcher, Keely said that “it's been focused on code efficiency and the architecture, and allowing us to basically build features more quickly. It hasn't been about the artwork or the design style. There are some updates and changes, but that's been managed by our normal Epic Games design group.”
paragraphs.cn: 当被问及Epic在新版启动器中使用人工智能的具体范围时，Keely表示：「我们主要用AI改善代码效率和架构，让我们基本上能更快地开发功能。AI没有用于美术或设计风格。这些方面确实有一些更新和调整，但都由我们原有的Epic Games设计团队负责。」

paragraphs.en: It’s interesting that this line has been drawn for the launcher, as Epic has been pretty open about how it’s used generative AI to help create Fortnite skins . The studio’s in-development Star Wars and Marvel crossover shooter is also reported to be using AI for its artistic assets, with Bloomberg’s report noting that all art for the project would be "generated with full AI workflows."
paragraphs.cn: 有意思的是，Epic在启动器上划定了这条界限，却一直相当坦率地谈论如何使用生成式AI辅助制作《堡垒之夜》皮肤。据报道，该工作室正在开发的《星球大战》与漫威联动射击游戏也在使用AI制作美术素材。彭博社的报道指出，该项目的所有美术内容都将「通过全套AI工作流程生成」。

paragraphs.en: We’ve known about Epic’s plans for a new launcher for a while – we previously spoke to Keely’s predecessor, Steve Allison, who said that the app “should feel fast and snappy and just be what you expect, frankly” in our extensive interview . Of course, Epic also faces a cultural battle, as most PC players have been embedded in Valve’s Steam ecosystem for decades, with some convinced that the Epic Games Store will never be as good as Steam.
paragraphs.cn: 我们早已得知Epic计划推出新启动器。此前，我们曾对Keely的前任Steve Allison做过一次深入采访，他当时表示，这款应用「应该运行流畅、响应迅速，坦白说，就是达到大家预期的样子」。当然，Epic还得面对玩家使用习惯带来的阻力：大多数PC玩家已经在Valve的Steam生态中待了数十年，其中一些人坚信，Epic游戏商城永远也比不上Steam。

paragraphs.en: Matt Purslow is IGN's Executive Editor of Features.
